Within the combinatorial methodology of the *Paṭṭhāna*, this text addresses the dyads related to the group of clinging or grasping (*upādāna-gocchaka*) in conjunction with the primary triad of wholesome, unwholesome, and undetermined phenomena (*kusalattika*).
